scope: Randomized variants of Holy Nova and Demoralizing Shout, the two spells a live request reached that Rust did not run. Holy Nova: every rank (15237, 15430, 15431, 27799, 27800 and 27801) cast by a Shadow Priest without Shadowform and by a Smite Priest against 1, 3 and 5 targets, 144 variants of 36 requests, plus the 8 accepted Priest fixtures that cast it, a Shadow Priest in Shadowform included. Demoralizing Shout: a Protection Warrior tanking 1, 3 and 5 targets, with and without the raid's permanent Demoralizing Roar or Shout debuff, and a Fury Warrior against 1, 3 and 5 targets, plus the 8 accepted Warrior fixtures. 258 variants of 60 requests at 200 iterations, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. Each variant draws its race from the races of its class.
generator: python3 tools/live_spell_sweep.py --output <scratch>, which draws the variants of tools/sweep.py (seed 20261009 plus the row's position, 200 iterations, melee range for the Warriors) from the accepted requests with the Holy Nova rank the row names in the rotation, 4 variants of each rank and 4 to 5 of each Warrior request and fixture; each variant <scratch>/NAME-sweep-NN.request.json is compared as variants/NAME-sweep-NN.request.json

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every variant matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log. 181 of the 184 Priest variants cast Holy Nova in the first fight, 116 of them hit more than one target, and every rank is cast. All 74 Warrior variants cast Demoralizing Shout, and its debuff is gained in the first fight of 60 of them; in the other 14 the raid's permanent Demoralizing Roar or Shout debuff, which bids the same, outlasts it and holds it off. The Shadow Priest fixture in Shadowform never casts it, as Go refuses it through its cast requirement.
The variants lower talents (a Priest keeps Holy Nova's), drop buffs, debuffs, consumables and gear and change the target level, distance, reaction time and random stream mode.
